description: No debug artifacts left in source code (console.log, debugger, IO.inspect, binding.pry)
what: Found debug artifact in production source code
why: Debug artifacts pollute production logs, expose internal state, and may crash environments that lack dev tooling
fix: Remove the debug statement from the reported file and line. To observe this value in production, use the structured logger (Logger.info / console.error / log.Info) instead.

description: No TODO or FIXME comments left in committed code
what: Found a TODO/FIXME comment in production source code
why: TODO comments represent unfinished work being committed — they accumulate and never get resolved, and agents treat them as authoritative design intent
fix: Either complete the work now, or open a ticket and remove the comment. If the decision is non-obvious, log it in DECISIONS.md instead.

description: No hardcoded secrets or API keys in source
what: Found what looks like a hardcoded secret or API key in source code
why: Hardcoded secrets end up in git history and cannot be safely rotated — the only fix is key rotation, not deletion
fix: Move the value to an environment variable. Add the variable name to .env.example with a placeholder. Load it via process.env.KEY / System.get_env('KEY') / os.environ['KEY'].

check: jq empty feature_list.json 2>/dev/null || (echo 'feature_list.json missing or invalid' && exit 1)
what: feature_list.json is missing or contains a JSON syntax error
why: Invalid JSON breaks make vcr, verify-feature.sh, and the entire feature state machine
fix: Run 'jq . feature_list.json' to see the parse error. Fix the malformed JSON at the reported line, or create the file if it is missing.

description: No direct database queries outside the repository/data layer
what: Found a direct database query outside the repository layer
why: Database access from controllers or services bypasses transaction management and makes queries impossible to test in isolation
fix: Move the query into the repository layer (e.g. lib/myapp/repo/ or src/repositories/). Call the repo function from the service or controller — never query the DB directly from those layers.
